items.title: Injured players miss the games their injury says they miss
items.stageRationale: FORGE/FB beta hardening: a measured core-loop defect. Injury pressure is a General Manager decision driver, and 85% of the shortest absences currently cost nothing.
items.recipe: Run the weekly availability recovery after the week's games and before that week's injury rolls, so a recovery week elapses only for a game the player actually missed and a fresh injury is never decremented before its first absence. Keep the season-end (no week block) recovery tick. Preserve every pay, pension and admitted-injury interval contract.
items.acceptance: Canonical-path probe: among players whose team played the next week, Out 1W dress 0 times in the next game; Out 2-3W miss two games; IR (4W) misses four. Focused regression test proves the labelled absence end to end through advanceWeek. Full native suite green; any golden-master movement is re-measured and explained, never re-baselined blind.

premises.claim: Weekly recovery runs before the week's games, ahead of waivers and simulation.
The recovery clears a player as soon as weeksRemaining reaches zero; dressed-roster eligibility admits weeksRemaining <= 0.

L1.recipe: Relabel severities to describe what they do (recovery weeks, not games missed). Truthful but removes the intended pressure; unselected.

L2.recipe: Move the regular-season recovery tick after simulation and before injury rolls; keep the season-end tick; prove absences by probe and focused test.

L3.recipe: Add NFL-style weekly practice participation and usage-based wear feeding the injury roll. Unselected.

items.evidence: Engine probe, seed 131, one regular season: Out 1W 300 injuries, 257 dressed for the very next game; Questionable 419, 357 dressed; Out 2-3W 0 of 201 dressed next game but only one game missed by construction (2 - 1 = 1).
items.insight: Recovery is decremented at the start of the following week, before kickoff, so every injury costs exactly one game fewer than its label. Two thirds of all injuries were cosmetic.
items.premise: Weekly recovery runs before the week's games, ahead of waivers and simulation. The recovery clears a player as soon as weeksRemaining reaches zero; dressed-roster eligibility admits weeksRemaining <= 0.

executionLog.note: L2 verified: GameSession ticks regular-season recovery after the week's games (after both injury sources), and kickoff readiness reads live injury state. Engine probe seed 131 games missed by label — Out 1W 0:297/316 before, 1:279/330 after (residual 0s are team byes); Out 2-3W 1→2; IR(4W) 3→4; IR-Long 6-7→7-8. test/injury-clock-truth.test.js drives real advanceWeek against box-score game-day rosters; negative control: both clock tests fail on the pre-fix engine. Focused 29/29. Independent review: fix, 4 findings, 4 fixed. Postseason clock alignment carried as a follow-up.

items.title: Show Questionable as a game-time status, not as a recovered injury
items.stageRationale: FORGE/FB beta hardening: the profile currently tells the player a fresh Questionable tag is a recovered injury, and the roster shows a bare '(0)'.
items.recipe: Add one shared formatter for a player's injury line. Questionable (zero remaining weeks, still tagged) reads 'Questionable · expected to play this week'; multi-week injuries read 'Out · N game(s)'. Use it in the player profile medical fact, roster injury column and depth board row tag.
items.acceptance: Pure tests for null, Questionable, one-game and multi-game injuries plus malformed data; profile no longer says 'Recovered' for a live Questionable tag; roster shows the formatted label; depth board marks Questionable rows without removing them from the lineup. Visible in the browser on desktop and mobile in dark and light.

premises.claim: A live Questionable tag (weeksRemaining 0) is rendered as a recovered injury in the player profile.
The roster injury column prints the raw remaining-weeks number.

L1.recipe: Fix the profile sentence only. Unselected.

L2.recipe: One shared formatter used by profile, roster and depth board.

L3.recipe: Give Questionable a real game-day probability with a pre-game decision for the controlled team. Changes RNG stream and golden masters; unselected.

items.evidence: playerProfileNarrative.js:133 renders weeksRemaining === 0 as 'Recovered <type>'; injurySystem SEVERITY_TABLE stores Questionable with weeksRemaining 0 until the next weekly recovery clears it.
items.insight: The most common injury outcome is invisible or mislabeled on every surface a General Manager uses to set a lineup.
